name: dogfood-monorepo
description: DOGFOOD - Open-source, self-hosted hackathon submission and judging platform

scripts.dev: npm --workspace=@dogfood/shared run build && (npm --workspace=@dogfood/api run dev & npm --workspace=@dogfood/web run dev)
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@dogfood/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@dogfood/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@dogfood/web run typecheck
